headline: Security deposit hearings for 44 Loomis Street and 187 Pearl Street.
summary: The board will hold hearings on two security deposit disputes between tenants and landlords, one for 44 Loomis Street and one for 187 Pearl Street.
items: Hearing: Emily Pecora (tenant) vs. MDJ BTV LLC c/o Matthew Boudreau (landlord), security deposit case re: 44 Loomis Street
Hearing: Mathieson Jennings (tenant) vs. 187 Pearl Street LLC c/o Chris Mason (landlord), security deposit case re: 187 Pearl Street
